definitions.gloss: last quarter moon; waning half-moon; third quarter
definitions.explanation: The phase of the moon approximately one week after the full moon, when the left half of the moon is illuminated (as seen from the Northern Hemisphere).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{下弦|かげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧だ。
examples.english: Tonight is a last quarter moon.

examples.japanese: {下弦|かげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{真夜中|まよなか}→真夜中：05425_mayonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇|のぼ}る→昇る：12960_noboru⟧。
examples.english: The last quarter moon rises at midnight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{下弦|かげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、⟦やがて→やがて：03637_yagate⟧⟦{新月|しんげつ}→新月：17599_shingetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After the full moon, it passes through the last quarter and eventually becomes a new moon.

notes:
One of the four principal lunar phases. The word literally means 'lower bowstring,' referring to the shape of the half-moon resembling the lower half of a drawn bow.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{新月|しんげつ}→新月：17599_shingetsu⟧: new moon
- ⟦{上弦|じょうげん}→上弦：08869_jougen⟧: first quarter moon (waxing half-moon)
- ⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧: full moon
- {下弦|かげん}: last quarter moon (waning half-moon)
- ⟦{三日月|みかづき}→三日月：17597_mikazuki⟧: crescent moon

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下弦|かげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧: the last quarter moon

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{弦|げん}→弦：18409_gen⟧ means 'bowstring.' One explanation is that the half-moon sets with its flat edge facing downward, like a bow's lower string; another ties ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ and {下|か} to the first and second halves of the lunar month. The opposite is ⟦{上弦|じょうげん}→上弦：08869_jougen⟧ (upper bowstring).
